# Avid Law Corporation (安胜 · 弘人律师行)

> Avid Law Corporation is a premier full-service Canadian law firm based in Richmond, British Columbia. Founded in 2009 (merging CNS Law Corporation and Redman Law), our firm provides comprehensive multilingual legal counsel in Corporate & Commercial Law, Commercial Real Estate Conveyancing, Civil Litigation, Wills & Estates, and Family Law across English, Mandarin, and Cantonese.

## Firm Summary
- **Entity Type**: Law Firm / Barristers & Solicitors
- **Jurisdiction**: British Columbia, Canada (Law Society of British Columbia)
- **Primary Service Areas**: Greater Vancouver, Metro Vancouver (Richmond, Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey)
- **Languages**: English, Mandarin (普通话), Cantonese (粤语), Korean (한국어)
- **Main Phone**: +1-604-273-7565

## Core Practice Areas & Statutory In-Depth Guides

### 1. Corporate & Commercial Law
- [Business Purchase & Sale in BC](https://www.avid-law.com/en/practice-areas/business-purchase-sale): Asset purchase agreements (APA), share purchase agreements (SPA), Section 85 rollover tax elections, PPSA due diligence, bulk sales clearance, and corporate restructuring under the BC Business Corporations Act [SBC 2002] c. 57.
- [Shareholder & Partnership Agreements](https://www.avid-law.com/en/practice-areas/shareholder-agreements): Unanimous shareholder agreements (USA), shotgun buy-sell clauses, right of first refusal (ROFR), pre-emptive rights, deadlock resolution, and drag-along / tag-along provisions.

### 2. Commercial Real Estate & Conveyancing
- [Commercial Real Estate, LOTR & Title Acquisitions](https://www.avid-law.com/en/practice-areas/commercial-real-estate): Commercial acquisitions, Land Owner Transparency Act (LOTA / LOTR) transparency declarations, Land Title Act conveyance, GST/Property Transfer Tax (PTT) structuring, and institutional mortgage financing.
- [Commercial Leasing & Lease Negotiation](https://www.avid-law.com/en/practice-areas/commercial-leasing): Triple-net (NNN) commercial lease drafting, landlord-tenant disputes, rent distress, lease assignments, sub-leases, and commercial tenancy enforcement under the Commercial Tenancy Act [RSBC 1996] c. 57.

### 3. Civil & Commercial Litigation
- [Shareholder, Contract & Commercial Disputes](https://www.avid-law.com/en/practice-areas/shareholder-commercial-disputes): Advocacy in BC Supreme Court and Court of Appeal for oppression remedies (BCBCA s. 227), corporate derivative actions, breach of contract, commercial debt collection, construction liens, and Anton Piller injunctions.

### 4. Wills, Trusts & Estate Administration
- [BC Wills, Probate Administration & Estate Planning](https://www.avid-law.com/en/practice-areas/wills-probate-estate-planning): Estate planning under the Wills, Estates and Succession Act [SBC 2009] c. 13 (WESA), grant of probate applications, letters of administration, enduring powers of attorney, representation agreements (s. 7 & s. 9), and wills variation claims.

### 5. Family Law
- Marriage agreements (prenuptial), separation agreements, child support, spousal support, property division under the BC Family Law Act [SBC 2011] c. 25, and uncontested/litigated divorce orders under the federal Divorce Act.
